name: OpenImageIO / oiiotool
role: VFX-grade CLI for EXR, sequences and OCIO colour conversion; stack-based image operations
summary: oiiotool is the command-line front end to OpenImageIO. It reads and writes EXR, TIFF, PNG, DPX, HDR and many more, keeps an image stack processed left to right, and offers resize, crop, composite, diff, metadata editing and --colorconvert via OpenColorIO. Sequences are addressed with frame wildcards, --frames and --parallel-frames. Strength: float, multichannel and colour-managed work that ImageMagick handles poorly.
use_when: EXR or other float and multichannel images, including AOV channel shuffling
Colour-managed conversion of a numbered sequence (ACEScg to sRGB) via OCIO
Over ImageMagick when bit depth, metadata or channel names must survive
Frame diffs with thresholds on production formats
avoid_when: Ordinary web stills: ImageMagick has the shorter command lines and is validated
Colour config authoring only: OpenColorIO tools
